title: How Precious Is Your Steadfast Love

questions.question: Transgression speaks to the wicked deep in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:1 (ESV): "Transgression speaks to the wicked deep in his heart;"

questions.question: There is no fear of whom before his eyes?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:1 (ESV): "...there is no fear of God before his eyes."

questions.question: He plots trouble while on his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:4 (ESV): "He plots trouble while on his bed;"

questions.question: Your steadfast love, O Lord, extends to where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:5 (ESV): "Your steadfast love, O Lord, extends to the heavens, your faithfulness to the clouds."

questions.question: Your righteousness is like the mountains of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:6 (ESV): "Your righteousness is like the mountains of God;"

questions.question: How precious is your what, O God!
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:7 (ESV): "How precious is your steadfast love, O God!"

questions.question: The children of mankind take refuge in the shadow of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:7 (ESV): "...The children of mankind take refuge in the shadow of your wings."

questions.question: They feast on the abundance of your house, and you give them drink from the river of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:8 (ESV): "...and you give them drink from the river of your delights."

questions.question: For with you is the fountain of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:9 (ESV): "For with you is the fountain of life; in your light do we see light."

questions.question: Let not the foot of arrogance come upon me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:11 (ESV): "...nor the hand of the wicked drive me away."

questions.question: There the evildoers lie fallen; they are thrust down, unable to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:12 (ESV): "There the evildoers lie fallen; they are thrust down, unable to rise."

questions.question: For he flatters himself in his own eyes that his iniquity cannot be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:2 (ESV): "For he flatters himself in his own eyes that his iniquity cannot be found out and hated."

questions.question: The words of his mouth are trouble and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:3 (ESV): "The words of his mouth are trouble and deceit;"

questions.question: He has ceased to act wisely and do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 36:3 (ESV): "...he has ceased to act wisely and do good."

questions.question: He sets himself in a way that is not good; he does not spurn what?

key_verse_text: How precious is your steadfast love, O God! The children of mankind take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
